scope: Separately registered official filename-loader compatibility repair; no strategy or economic evaluation change.
pre_review_requirements: New module only; old task_bc_v1, selected weights, default and parent failed outcome remain byte-identical.

Before any complete-game dispatch, freeze new source plus installed official loader/engine and all inherited decision/model dependencies; bind independent pre-review and exact registration/freeze Git blobs.

Real official filename-loader regression reproduces the old missing __file__ failure without injecting globals. New wrapper and frozen Worker loader on two consecutive saved observations must produce the same complete action and decision trace as direct frozen JointAgent.

Use absolute wrapper paths from a non-project working directory. Preserve source file identity via official compile filename; do not rely on launcher cwd, editing official loader, or broad fallback that changes policy.
Official loader exception can leave its appended sys.path behind; regression must isolate that failure or restore process search-path state before positive comparisons.
Regression trace outputs and full-game outputs are distinct; tests perform no official transitions or training.

Game runner permits only fixed seed 31205138, trained model, round2 and seats 0/1; at most two complete-game attempts. Record attempts before launch; failure stops remaining dispatch with no retry/replacement.
Required historical target hashes come from retained parent ledger; success cannot be inferred from an exit code or newly generated self-consistent receipt alone.

post_execution_review.all_available_rows: Check attempted versus completed counts, actual filename-loader execution, model/source identities, 720 states/719 actions/DONE, zero errors/fallback, action and complete trace equality to parent trained targets, v1/v2 semantic digest, final money and rewards.
post_execution_review.missing_sample_rule: No substitution and no reviewer-generated game if an entry fails or is unstarted.
post_execution_review.audit_reuse: Reuse frozen task_bc_v1.games.audit on independently identity-checked copied fixed model and opponent inputs; independently compare raw actions/traces and hashes against parent replay rather than relying solely on that audit.
post_execution_review.preservation: Check pre-stage protected history unchanged; only explicitly permitted old review-document complete-prefix appends at publication.
post_execution_review.interpretation: Two historical repetitions do not add economic samples or change parent -155 mean difference. Parent failed acceptance remains failed even if separate repair succeeds.

limitations: This preimplementation plan is not code approval or execution evidence. Future pre-review must bind actual new source/freeze hashes.
